subject: general
question:
The following pie charts show the percentage of employees in each department and the percentage of males working in each department.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9af674a47abc81b25a5d86308156a90db3187fe9560fa4daa37443b101df89d.png] 

 **Total number of Employees = 5100**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed6d2a3b83a5cebf449a72375a8fafb22532535d90398e20e6f196bf40a06180.png] 

 Total number of Males = 2050

Find the number of females working in the production department.
solution:
**Calculation:**

Number of employees in production = 5100 × 20%

⇒ 1020

Number of male employees in production = 2050 × 48%

⇒ 984

So, female production = 1020 - 984

⇒ 36

**∴ The required answer is 36.**
